definition: Justin Zobel is an Australian computer scientist working in information retrieval, search engine technology, and research evaluation.
details: He is a Redmond Barry Distinguished Professor in the School of Computing and Information Systems at the University of Melbourne and serves as Pro Vice-Chancellor for Graduate & International Research.

explainer.lead: Justin Zobel is an Australian computer scientist.

contributions.name: His work at RMIT contributed to the development of scalable methods for indexing and searching large text collections.
His has published books Writing for Computer Science and How to Write a Better Thesis, co-authored with David Evans and Paul Gruba.
He has contributed to the development of efficient, scalable algorithms for managing and searching large-scale textual data.
He has worked on MG and later Zettair, text retrieval systems designed for high performance on modest hardware.

timeline.what: Zobel received his Ph.D. in computer science from the University of Melbourne in 1991.
